purpose: Recover and normalize structurally compatible site-level extractive records from existing historical repository data. This is a quarantined review registry, not the authoritative canonical catalog and not executable runtime input.

rules.runtimePromotionRequirement: Review site identity, coordinate authority, commodity mapping, source evidence and pipeline/logistics bindings before promoting any record.

selectionPolicy.requiredCoordinates: Finite latitude/longitude within legal bounds; legacy coordinates remain UNVERIFIED
selectionPolicy.requiredResourceType: Must already exist in the canonical catalog resource ontology
selectionPolicy.aliases: Same-country/resource/coordinate collisions retained but explicitly flagged, never auto-merged
selectionPolicy.simulationOnlyProfiles: Every mapped candidate has deterministic game-only values for reserve, production, grade, purity, recovery, throughput and capacity; never overwrite quantitative observed/reported fields with these values.
